## Attacks 1–7 — why INVALID (re-verified)

1. **Production mark reads:** `BuiltinPricingEngine.value` / `QuantLibPricingEngine.value` call `require_explicit_market`, then `_pricing_view` ← `terms.model_dump()` + `_snapshot_marks_from_terms(terms, market)`; only non-mark Position attr pulled is `duration`. Spot/vol/yield/etc. come from required snapshot helpers (`MissingMarketDataError` when absent). Attribution greek buckets use `MarketSnapshot` maps only (`.get(..., 0.0)` defaults — market maps, not Position marks). No `getattr(position, "price"|"yield_rate"|...)` in `backend/app/`.
2. **DTO fields:** All `*Position` types inherit `PositionHierarchyMixin` with `extra='forbid'`. Runtime check: mark-field set ∩ `model_fields` is empty for Equity/Bond/Swap/Option/FX/IR families.
3. **Silent Legacy/sample pricing:** `LegacyDemoPricingAdapter` absent from `app/interfaces/pricing.py`. Engines require explicit market. Pricing ignores a sneaked instance attr from `model_copy(update={"price": ...})` (PV follows snapshot; `model_dump` / `model_validate` remain economics-only / forbid). Not a production mark path.
4. **Adapter LWW:** `DemoSampleMarksSnapshotAdapter.snapshot` always raises `SampleMarksRemovedError`. `PositionMarketDataProvider` delegates to it. Ad-hoc `demo_market_snapshot` raises; canned demos only bind exact demo identities from `_DEMO_*` tables. SAMPLE books are economics-only (no mark kwargs in `sample.py`).
5. **Weakened tests:** Goldens migrated economics → explicit `MarketSnapshot` with **same** pin values (e.g. full-reval `[-100, 0, 50]`, authority `999.0` divergence). No new `skip`/`xfail` on authority/golden suites. Full-suite skips are pre-existing nightly/Postgres gates.
6. **Competing USD DTO rates:** `yield_rate` / `market_swap_rate` rejected at construction (`extra_forbidden`); regressions in `test_demo_snapshot_adapter.py` / `test_value_requires_market.py`.
7. **FINDINGS:** Header and RF-001 body remain **IN PROGRESS** (Phase B pending orchestrator close). Not prematurely CLOSED.
